scripts.serve:pwa: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH && ng build && cp dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.csr.html dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.html && npx http-server dist/teacher-pwa/browser -p 4200 -a 0.0.0.0 --cors -c-1 -P http://127.0.0.1:3000
scripts.serve:pwa:https: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH && ng build && cp dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.csr.html dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.html && npx http-server dist/teacher-pwa/browser -p 4200 -a 0.0.0.0 --cors -c-1 -S -C .dev-certs/cert.pem -K .dev-certs/key.pem -P http://127.0.0.1:3000
scripts.serve:pwa:tunnel: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH && ng build && cp dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.csr.html dist/teacher-pwa/browser/index.html && npx http-server dist/teacher-pwa/browser -p 4200 -a 0.0.0.0 --cors -c-1 -P http://127.0.0.1:3000 & sleep 2 && npx -y cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:4200
scripts.start:dev:tunnel: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH && (ng serve --proxy-config proxy.conf.json --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4200 --allowed-hosts true & sleep 6 && npx -y cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:4200)
